stem: A test's success metric is conversion. Its guardrail, average delivery time, fell by 3% relative, an improvement, while conversion did not move. A manager wants to ship because "a metric improved". What is wrong?

options.text: Nothing: any metric that improves is a good enough reason to ship
A guardrail that improves like this shows that the test must have a logging bug
Delivery time should now replace conversion as the success metric
A guardrail only has to stay within its tolerance; it is not a reason to ship
